confidence_notes: Recent 2026 city-price entries inform food, coffee and beer; July accommodation is more uncertain because peak-season demand and Benidorm's large hotel supply pull in opposite directions. comparable_city_reasoning: For July, estimate rooms slightly above the supplied year-typical Alicante and Marbella prices, reflecting coastal demand, while staying below Barcelona. Large resort supply keeps hostel prices near the Alicante to Barcelona range.
